notes.title: Update - v2.8.0
notes.notes:
We’ve deployed Update 2.8.0 with a focus on refining the core gameplay experience and integrating new features into the expanding Polygon Art ecosystem:

[b]AI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Significantly improved AI reaction time and frequency for a more responsive and intense combat experience.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Handling Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Refined weapon handling for smoother aiming and firing.
[*] Added weapon sway to improve realism and immersion during movement and aiming.
[/list]

[b]PANet Integration[/b]
Beyond Enemy Lines – Remastered Edition is now connected to PANet!
Check your personal stats and progress online: [url=https://polygon-art.com/stats/]https://polygon-art.com/stats/[/url]

Our next title [b]Beyond Enemy Lines – Vietnam is now live with a free demo[/b] on Steam.
Explore the jungle, test your tactics, and experience the future of the franchise.
[b]Don't forget to add it to your wishlist to stay updated![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1467270/Beyond_Enemy_Lines__Vietnam/

notes.title: Update v2.5.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] added Field of View option (60-100)
[/list]

Please note this is an optional feature and the game is meant to be played at default Field of View (90). Increasing or lowering the Field of View can but not must result in broken first person animations.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Agents,

the PC version of BEL Remastered Edition is slowly shaping up. Right now we are replacing the old weapon models with new, high quality models with better animations, sounds and gunplay as well as overhauling the overall game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37481949/386523295fde4859f695d7f6e2d73a2c7eaec4d2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37481949/34348b365573c2edd560b5999c5c2eea73031d2b.png[/img]

We don't have an exact release date but we are working hard to get it live on Steam as soon as possible!
